sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·莫丹尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 免费直播精选访谈，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得一个月的免费阅读权限，畅享我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名举报人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触的投诉。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我和乌克兰总统进行了一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，非常完美。

sentences.en: Today, I am asking our chairman to proceed with articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正要求我们的主席推进弹劾条款。

sentences.en: This week, Democrats are expected to approve two articles of impeachment on a straight party-line vote, setting up a Senate trial early next year.
sentences.zh: 本周，预计民主党人将在完全按党派划线的投票中批准两项弹劾条款，为明年初的参议院审判做准备。

sentences.en: It's Julie Davis in the Washington Bureau of the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》华盛顿分社的朱莉·戴维斯。

sentences.en: The news from here is all about the rules.
sentences.zh: 这里传出的消息全都是关于规则的。

sentences.en: The Rules Committee will come to order.
sentences.zh: 规则委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: House Democrats are spending Tuesday figuring out the rules for the impeachment vote Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 众议院民主党人周二正忙着制定周三弹劾投票的规则。

sentences.en: There are cameras present, and that means members of Congress are taking the chance to speechify a little bit.
sentences.zh: 现场有摄像机，这意味着国会议员们正趁机发表一番演讲。

sentences.en: You know, when I think back to the founders of this nation, they were particularly concerned about foreign interference in our elections.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每当我回想起这个国家的奠基人，他们特别关切的是外国对我们选举的干涉。

sentences.en: The rules the House will adopt will give House Speaker Nancy Pelosi a lot of control over how the impeachment vote plays out Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 众议院将采用的规则将赋予众议院议长南希·佩洛西很大的控制权，决定周三的弹劾投票如何展开。

sentences.en: No amendments allowed, a set period for debate equally divided between both sides, no extra time.
sentences.zh: 不允许修正案，规定辩论时间并在双方之间平均分配，不延长额外时间。

sentences.en: All this leaves very little room for Republicans to shape the debate ahead of the vote to impeach President Trump for abusive power and for obstructing
sentences.zh: 所有这一切几乎没有给共和党人留下什么空间，来在以滥用职权和妨碍

sentences.en: Congress.
sentences.zh: 国会为由弹劾特朗普总统的投票之前，塑造辩论的走向。

sentences.en: Moments like this call for more than just reflexive partisanship.
sentences.zh: 这样的时刻需要的不仅仅是本能的党派偏见。

sentences.en: They require honesty.
sentences.zh: 它们需要诚实。

sentences.en: But the latest is the debate that's been unfolding about the impeachment rules in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但最新情况是美国参议院围绕弹劾规则展开的辩论，

sentences.en: Senate, where the next phase, the trial phase of this whole thing, will happen, where the actual vote on whether to remove President Trump from office will take place.
sentences.zh: 整个事件的下一个阶段——审判阶段将在这里发生，罢免特朗普总统与否的实际投票也将在这里举行。

sentences.en: Things are very different there.
sentences.zh: 那里的情况非常不同。

sentences.en: Republicans, not Democrats, are in charge, and the question of how this trial will proceed is up in the air.
sentences.zh: 掌权的是共和党人，而不是民主党人，这场审判将如何进行还是个未知数。

sentences.en: The Democratic leader decided to short-circuit the customary and collegial process.
sentences.zh: 民主党领袖决定绕过惯常的、讲究同僚情谊的程序。

sentences.en: There's a fight developing between the Senate majority leader, Mitch McConnell, and his
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔与他的

sentences.en: Democratic counterpart, Senator Chuck Schumer, that brings this into focus.
sentences.zh: 民主党对手、参议员查克·舒默之间正在爆发一场争端，这让焦点更加凸显。

sentences.en: He chose to begin by writing me an 11-paragraph letter.
sentences.zh: 他选择首先给我写了一封11段长的信。

sentences.en: In a letter to McConnell over the weekend, Schumer proposed that the Senate call for witnesses
sentences.zh: 在周末写给麦康奈尔的一封信中，舒默提议参议院传唤

sentences.en: who we know are critical to understanding what went on with this Ukraine affair, but who wouldn't
sentences.zh: 那些我们知道对于理解乌克兰事件经过至关重要，但由于特朗普总统下令而拒绝

sentences.en: cooperate with the House investigation because President Trump ordered them not to, including
sentences.zh: 配合众议院调查的证人，包括

sentences.en: his chief of staff, Mick Mulvaney, and his former national security advisor, John Bolton.
sentences.zh: 他的办公厅主任米克·马尔瓦尼和前国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿。

sentences.en: Look, most people understand what the Democratic leader is really after.
sentences.zh: 听着，大多数人都明白民主党领袖真正的目的所在。

sentences.en: And Tuesday, McConnell goes on the Senate floor and basically says, no.
sentences.zh: 周二，麦康奈尔走上参议院发言台，基本上说了一个“不”字。

sentences.en: What House Democrats have assembled appears to be woefully, woefully inadequate to prove what they want to allege.
sentences.zh: 众议院民主党人拼凑出来的东西看起来极其、极其不足以证明他们想要指控的内容。

sentences.en: So now, the Senate Democratic leader would apparently like our chamber to do House Democrats' homework for them.
sentences.zh: 因此现在，参议院民主党领袖显然希望我们参议院来帮众议院民主党人做他们的家庭作业。

sentences.en: The democratically controlled House had their turn.
sentences.zh: 由民主党控制的众议院已经轮过一次了。

sentences.en: Why would we in the Senate call these witnesses to help Democrats make their case?
sentences.zh: 我们参议院凭什么要传唤这些证人来帮助民主党人证明他们的案子？

sentences.en: It's not the Senate's job to leap into the breach and search desperately for ways to get the guilty.
sentences.zh: 冲进缺口并拼命寻找给有罪者定罪的方法，这不是参议院的工作。

sentences.en: We certainly do not need jurors to start brainstorming witnesses, witness lists for the prosecution and demanding to lock them in before we've even heard opening arguments.
sentences.zh: 我们当然不需要陪审团在甚至还没听到开场陈述之前，就开始集思广益地为控方列出证人名单，并要求将其固定下来。

sentences.en: Outwardly, it may seem that Senator McConnell has all the power, that he can set the rules about what happens in the Senate trial, just like Democrats in the majority in the House
sentences.zh: 表面上看，似乎参议院领袖麦康奈尔掌握了所有权力，他可以为参议院审判中发生的事情制定规则，就像在众议院占多数的民主党人

sentences.en: set the rules for their inquiry.
sentences.zh: 为他们的调查制定规则一样。

sentences.en: But it's not that simple.
sentences.zh: 但事情没那么简单。

sentences.en: In the Senate, you need consensus to proceed, no objections.
sentences.zh: 在参议院，你需要达成共识才能推进，必须没有异议。

sentences.en: And if you want to get past any objections, you need a majority and you need a vote.
sentences.zh: 如果你想克服任何异议，你需要多数票，你需要进行投票。

sentences.en: And there are a very small number of moderate Republicans, Republicans up for re-election
sentences.zh: 而且有一小部分温和派共和党人，明年面临连任且

sentences.en: next year who are vulnerable, Susan Collins of Maine, Cory Gardner of Colorado, plus Republicans
sentences.zh: 处境脆弱的共和党人，比如缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯、科罗拉多的科里·加德纳，再加上那些

sentences.en: who've been willing to buck the president on occasion, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, Mitt Romney of Utah, who could be very influential in this process.
sentences.zh: 偶尔愿意与总统唱反调的共和党人，比如阿拉斯加州的丽莎·穆尔科斯基、犹他州的米特·罗姆尼，他们在这一过程中可能会非常有影响力。

sentences.en: These are people who are not necessarily excited about casting a vote to acquit the president
sentences.zh: 这些人不一定热衷于投出宣告总统无罪的票，

sentences.en: anyway, and they don't want to take a bunch of votes where they look like they're being partisan or unfair or not respecting the gravity of the impeachment process.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也不想投出一系列让自己显得党派性强、不公正或不尊重弹劾过程之严肃性的票。

sentences.en: And what that means is that McConnell has to engage with Schumer on some level about the rules of the Senate trial, including the question of what witnesses to call, if any.
sentences.zh: 这意味着麦康奈尔必须在某种程度上与舒默就参议院审判的规则进行接触，包括传唤哪些证人（如果有的话）的问题。

sentences.en: The preferable path would have been an in-person conversation, which nonetheless I still hope to pursue.
sentences.zh: 更可取的途径本该是进行面对面的交谈，尽管我仍然希望能继续追求这一点。

sentences.en: After his floor speech, McConnell took questions from reporters and said, look.
sentences.zh: 在发表完发言台演讲后，麦康奈尔接受了记者的提问并表示，听着。

sentences.en: I'm not an impartial juror.
sentences.zh: 我不是一个公正的陪审员。

sentences.en: This is all political, and I'm not going to pretend I'm impartial.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是政治，我不会假装自己是公正的。

sentences.en: This is a political process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个政治过程。

sentences.en: There's not anything judicial about it.
sentences.zh: 这里面没有任何司法性质。

sentences.en: Impeachment is a political decision.
sentences.zh: 弹劾是一个政治决定。

sentences.en: The House made a partisan political decision to impeach.
sentences.zh: 众议院做出了一个党派化的政治决定来进行弹劾。

sentences.en: I would anticipate we will have a largely partisan outcome in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 我预计我们在参议院也会得到一个很大程度上带有党派色彩的结果。

sentences.en: I'm not impartial about this at all.
sentences.zh: 我对这件事一点也不公正。

sentences.en: Not long after that...
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久……

sentences.en: I am utterly amazed what Mitch McConnell said.
sentences.zh: 我对米奇·麦康奈尔所说的话感到无比震惊。

sentences.en: Chuck Schumer stands in the exact same spot and puts the onus right on those moderate Senate
sentences.zh: 查克·舒默站在完全相同的位置上，将责任直接压在那些温和派参议院

sentences.en: Republicans.
sentences.zh: 共和党人身上。

sentences.en: Mitch McConnell said proudly he is not an impartial juror.
sentences.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔自豪地宣称他不是一个公正的陪审员。

sentences.en: I would ask every one of my Republican Senate colleagues, are you impartial jurors, or are you like Mitch McConnell, proud not to be one?
sentences.zh: 我要问我的每一位共和党参议院同僚，你们是公正的陪审员，还是像米奇·麦康奈尔那样，为自己不是而感到自豪？

sentences.en: Are you going to be impartial?
sentences.zh: 你们会保持公正吗？

sentences.en: Unlike in the democratically controlled House, where Republicans have had to stand idly by in
sentences.zh: 与民主党控制的众议院不同，在那里共和党人在

sentences.en: a lot of ways, while Democrats ran the process the way they wanted to, Democrats in the Senate do have a say.
sentences.zh: 很多方面只能袖手旁观，看着民主党人按照他们想要的方式主导程序，参议院的民主党人确实拥有发言权。

sentences.en: And Senator Schumer seems like he's ready to try to force the issue and make things awkward for moderate Republicans.
sentences.zh: 而舒默参议员似乎准备好尝试强行推进议题，让温和派共和党人陷入尴尬境地。

sentences.en: And you're seeing that at the start of the process right now.
sentences.zh: 你在这一过程的开始阶段就已经看到了这一点。

sentences.en: So that's the latest from Washington.
sentences.zh: 这就是来自华盛顿的最新消息。

sentences.en: Next, an impeachment vote Wednesday in the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 接下来，众议院将在周三进行弹劾投票。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和主持人萨拉·科尼格将带您聆听那些试图维持影响力却在不知不觉中失去控制的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何平台上收听。
